method: Exact scalar Fourier polynomial products and physical derivatives, then solve periodic pressure; no primary imports, no cutoff.
equation: u'=Delta u-P((u dot grad)u), viscosity 1, unforced, fixed (R/(2*pi*Z))^3

definitions.C_tree_s_plus: B(a,C)/2; equals s_plus only at q, not as a full field
definitions.C_tree_s_minus: B(C,a)/2; equals s_minus only at q, not as a full field

time_contract.decomposition: S is the six initial wavevectors, l=P_S u, w=(I-P_S)u; both are projections of the same full solution.
time_contract.structural_zero: q is absent from S+S and S+support(N), so B(l,l)_q=B(l,N)_q=B(N,l)_q=0 regardless of current seed amplitudes or phases.
time_contract.scope: Exact inequalities certify constants in the accompanying full-PDE analytic argument. No closed spectral evolution, equal-amplitude assumption, or omitted off-seed tail is used.

revision_note: An earlier auxiliary heat-seed decomposition was superseded by the actual current-support split. It is not part of this certificate or theorem.

primary_comparison.note: Primary tighter square-root brackets are independently verified. Their margins need not equal the separately chosen broader independent bounds.

limits: Bounded exact algebra and rational inequalities for the accompanying positive-time analytic contract only.
Norm dominance over net seed forcing does not imply dominance over the sum of absolute ordered channel lengths.
The infinite-dimensional remainder proof remains a mathematical input beyond finite coefficient checks.
No autonomous regeneration, iteration, infinite scale, or singularity conclusion.
